title: LG V40 lock screen reading delay
body: I'm running Android 8.1.0 on my new LG and find that the lock screen value is not updating.  I can restart the collector and it will update, but it will stay on that value until I restart again.  All other values on the home screen and top bar when unlocked match the current value, its just the lock screen which wont update.  Is there a setting I am missing? Thank you.

comments.body: I experienced the same issue previously and solved it by restarting my LG G5. It has not reoccurred since. Please let us know if this fixes your issue.

> I experienced the same issue previously and solved it by restarting my LG G5. It has not reoccurred since. Please let us know if this fixes your issue.

Hello! Yes I have restarted my phone which didnt seem to cure it.  I just switched from a Note8 and saved all my settings onto my SD card, but it's unable to download.  I'll keep checking different settings. I'm on version 14fecb8-2019.01.10

I know this will not fix the issue, but as an alternative method, if you still have access to your Note 8, there is an option in xDrip to create a QR code to transfer settings. Select "copy all settings" and scan the resulting QR code with your knew phone.

Update: I now get what you mean. The problem does not reside in the lock screen itself, but in the _always on_ lock screen. Although the BG value in the notification on the lock screen is updated, the _always on_ lock screen value is either delayed, or stuck on 6.8, which seems to be the default value. I don't think this is a bug in xDrip, but rather Android.

Can somebody point me in the right direction where the BG value is enabled to be displayed on the Lock Screen?    It used to update properly, but now it is frozen at 100.    So I think I want to remove that.  (Especially since I have an Android Watch that has the xDrip+ face working!)

Sadly, I just can not find where I turned that on...    I've been through every menu I can find, and so far, the Enable/Disable for that feature is out smarting me.
